description:
A developer account 'jmonroe' has been locked out due to excessive failed login attempts. Your task is to unlock this account and reset the password. 

1. Log in to Artifactory (admin/password).
2. Navigate to the User Management section in Administration.
3. Locate user 'jmonroe', unlock the account, and set the new password to 'TemporaryFix#2024'.
4. Ensure the user remains in the 'backend-devs' group (do not delete and recreate the user).
5. Verify the account is unlocked.
